The removal of the decoder assignment in `au0828-cards.c` is compensated by the new logic in `au0828-core.c`, where the decoder is now cached directly in the `au0828_dev` structure. This ensures that both the tuner and decoder are properly managed and cached for the `au0828_enable_source()` function to work correctly.
